findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：絕大多數會員經經紀人通路取得，經紀人多用EDE平台於交易所投保，Oscar以佣金與獎金結構競爭；ICHRA員工亦可購買其方案，多數在交易所外購買。
findings.excerpt: The vast majority of our membership is acquired through the broker channel, and brokers typically use an EDE platform to enroll the members in plans offered on the Health Insurance Marketplace. As such, we compete through the commissions and bonus structures we pay these partners.

findings.claim: Oscar贊助之SureCo 2026 ICHRA報告：56%經紀人推薦ICHRA，移轉至少一客戶至ICHRA的經紀人比例由2024年15%升至2026年37%。
findings.source: Fierce Healthcare: Study: Brokers increasingly recommending ICHRA to employers

findings.claim: Oscar Investor Day：目標成為消費者偏好的AI原生保險商，拓展至ACA以外族群；Lucie市集為payer-agnostic。
findings.source: Quartr: Oscar Health Investor Day 2026 summary
findings.excerpt: Plans to expand beyond ACA, targeting gig workers, part-time employees, public program participants, and the broader individual market, with a goal to serve all 350 million Americans.
